raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in its "Updated Understanding" section of Step 1. It incorrectly stated that "Fish: ~530 million years ago (Cambrian explosion) per Britannica" was the baseline date to use. While the WebSurfer search in Step 1 did retrieve a snippet mentioning "530 million years ago," the Planner failed to verify this against the specific search query results which actually pointed to the Upper Ordovician (~450-480 mya) as the earliest *vertebrate* fossils (jawless fish) in the Britannica text visible. More importantly, the Planner's subsequent instructions and analysis repeatedly relied on this incorrect 530 mya figure as a definitive fact, leading to a flawed comparison where the age of fish was exaggerated. This premature acceptance of an unverified number from a search snippet, rather than extracting the precise date cited in the authoritative source (Upper Ordovician), constitutes a failure in systematic information gathering and verification. This error propagated through the conversation, causing the Planner to misinterpret the relative ages of the groups.
